segments.text: hello everyone and welcome to this lunch event session on flexible update management um today I'll walk you through the changes we're making to update management for your business Cent for environments from version 25 onwards in short we're massively increasing the flexibility with which you can manage your environment updates in response to uh feedback from some of our biggest customers and

partners um by doing this we're meeting the require ments of update diverse customers so these are customers that are running 24hour shops and don't want plan downtime every month or customers that have extensive testing requirements um that they don't want to repeat for every new version every month um we're doing it also to spread and reduce the workload of Partners so

partners that that manage many customer environments uh have many updates to run uh every major update and by increasing the flexibility with which these can be scheduled um we can spread and reduce their workload and then finally um having fewer updates or more flexib flexibility in managing these updates also makes it uh possible to operate more
efficiently so whenever exceptions are needed um you can now reschedule from the admin Center yourself rather than having to go through customer

support um the major update cycle for the past couple of release has um looked like this um so as with every major release we start with a preview period um that runs every March and every September and then every October and April we ship a new major

version um for the P releases um this major update would be scheduled around 7 days after it's first made available on every environment and then from that moment on administrators would have 60 days to um schedule that update and run it after that a grace period would start um and then finally an enforced update period would start in which any incompatible

extensions are uninstalled now what we heard a lot from our customers is that these 60 days are not enough in some cases so what we're changing with version 25 and further is um that the update period is increasing from 60 days to 5 months so now when version 25 ships on the 1st of October uh any environments

that are updating to this version we'll have until the 1st of March to do so um after the 1st of March we will start a grace period similar to before uh but the grace period is shortened so for one month the month of March um we'll run the updates every week um and it's no longer possible to schedule it for a later date and then finally from the 1st of April

we'll start the enforced update period so in this period um any environments that still have filed to update because of incompatibilities in installed extensions uh will be forced updated by uninstalling those extensions as part of the update with these changes the the grace period now aligns with the preview period for the next version so the moment the grace period for version
24 starts will start the preview for version 26 in March next year and then in April when we ship version 26 we'll start the force updating from version 24 to version

25 um with these changes um we'll refer to an update cycle only for major updates so the update cycle as I just said starts with a preview period that lasts for 30 days um after the preview period will start the regular update period this will always last for five calendar months and the end date is fixed so for the update that ships in
October the end date of the update period will always be the 1st of March and for the update that ships in April the end date will always be the 1st of

September um after the update period we continue with the grace period which um is shortened but behaves exactly as Grace periods uh for previous releases so during the grace periods we're scheduling the update every week it will run on the scheduled date and if it fills or reschedule it for a week later um during this period is not possible

to postpone the update uh to a later date so if we schedule uh the update after a field attempt to run 7 days after that attempt you can reschedule it to an earlier day you can say I want to try it again after 5 days but it's not possible to reschedule to a later date uh let's say to reschedule after 10

days um this gr period last for a month so uh in short that means that every environment update will be attempted four times and after that we'll start the enforced update period so this Peri period behaves much like the grace period with the exception that as part of this update will uninstall any apps that are not compatible with the next version of business Central

and also in this time it's not possible to postpone the update any further um minor updates on the other end don't have an update cycle anymore so we'll continue to ship them every month um and the default scheduling is unchanged so every month we'll ship it um 7 days after we ship it it will be scheduled on your environment um and then you

can res schedule it um but what is changing is that you can now opt out of automatic scheduling so we introduce a new environment level setting uh on your environment that you can use to say I want uh this update to be scheduled automatically yes or no and if you up out we will ship minor updates they'll be available on your environment
to update to but we will not schedule for you and you'd have to take action in the admin Center to get a minor update um what's also changing is with minor updates being opt

um you can uh fall behind multiple versions so if you don't install the latest minor every month you could be behind a few miners at some point um what we're changing now is that if you schedule an update you can select the target version for that update so you go into the admin Senter you want a schedule an update and you can take any version later than the version your environment is on

which makes it possible to um skip some versions and then finally uh what's also new is that you can create create environments on any supported version so in the admin Center when you create a new environment you'll be able to select any version number that we support um instead of the current behavior of just supporting the latest version

um of course if you create the environments by logging in to an tenant that doesn't have any business censal environment yet we'll always create the latest uh we'll always create an environment on the latest version these changes are rolling out gradually over the course of um the major releasee so the public review is starting in October 2024 when we ship version 25

and it only applies to Microsoft localized environments um that means that Microsoft localized environments they get a new update cycle so they get the five month window um and the update 25.0 when we ship it will be schedulable until the 1st of March
